faq.a1: A front skill is a reusable package of guidance — rules, examples and patterns — that helps humans and AI agents build better interfaces. Each skill ships with documentation and, when it matters, a visual before/after comparison.
faq.q2: How do I install a skill?
faq.a2: Copy the install command and run it in your project. You can install the whole collection or a single skill by appending its slug.
faq.q3: Do skills work with AI agents?
faq.a3: Yes. Skills are plain markdown with frontmatter, so any coding agent can read and apply them directly in your repository.
